title: Ext is homology of a termwise identified signed dual resolution
statement: Let A be a commutative ring with a derived category for its module category, X,Y A-modules, and P a projective resolution of X. Let L be a nonnegative cochain complex of A-modules, with A-module isomorphisms e_i:L_i -> Hom_A(P_i,Y). Suppose e_(i+1) composed with the differential of L equals (-1)^(i+1) times precomposition with the differential P_(i+1) -> P_i, after e_i, for every i. For every natural n there is an A-linear equivalence Ext^n_A(X,Y) -> H^n(L).

source.place: Lemma 48.15.5, total Hom computation, generalized to any projective resolution; Mathlib ProjectiveResolution.extAddEquivCohomologyClass and Cochain.delta_toSingleMk

proof.text: Set S=L.sc n. Evaluate a cycle x in ker(S.g) by e_n. The differential identity hd and invertibility of (-1)^(n+1) show d_(n+1) composed with e_n(x) vanishes. Define F(x)=P.extMk(e_n(x)); add_extMk proves additivity, and Ext.smul_eq_comp_mk₀ together with extMk_comp_mk₀ proves A-linearity. The term isomorphism e_n and extMk_surjective prove that F is surjective.

Identify ker F with range S.moduleCatToCycles. In degree p+1, extMk_eq_zero_iff says F(x)=0 precisely when e_(p+1)(x)=d_(p+1) composed with g. Its preimage boundary is d_L of e_p inverse applied to (-1)^(p+1) times g: hd and the square of the sign being 1 prove this formula. Conversely hd sends every L-boundary to a coboundary, with the sign absorbed in g. In degree zero, S.f=0 by the complex shape. The private proved helper extMk_zero_iff applies extEquivCohomologyClass and Cocycle.toSingleMk_mem_coboundaries_iff; the possible preceding target component is P.cochainComplex.X 1, a zero object since the resolution is strictly LE 0, so the Ext class vanishes exactly when its representing map vanishes. Thus ker F is zero in degree zero as required.

Apply LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective to F. Rewrite its kernel as the range of S.moduleCatToCycles by the preceding equality, then use S.moduleCatHomologyIso, the pinned Mathlib linear identification of homology with the kernel/image quotient. Reverse the first quotient equivalence and compose to obtain Ext^n(X,Y) linearly equivalent to L.homology n.

proof_origin.place: Total Hom computation, implemented using the pinned Mathlib ProjectiveResolution.extMk API, degree-zero cocycle comparison, and ShortComplex.moduleCatHomologyIso; G3 stage 3

lean.statement: theorem exists_ext_signed_dual_homology_equiv (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} A)] {X Y : ModuleCat.{u} A} (P : ProjectiveResolution X) (L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℕ) (e : ∀ i, L.X i ≅ ModuleCat.of A (P.complex.X i ⟶ Y)) (hd : ∀ i, L.d i (i + 1) ≫ (e (i + 1)).hom = (e i).hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom ((-1 : A) ^ (i + 1) • Linear.leftComp A Y (P.complex.d (i + 1) i))) (n : ℕ) : Nonempty (Abelian.Ext X Y n ≃ₗ[A] L.homology n)
